At exact HEAD 2d2f663d30b1d22b2ce4b802bf0b3ecb69d26622, with no archived session payload inspected, Review-004 is disposed as follows. Standards: S1 cleanup/promote contradiction is sustained; S2 raw-range identity defect is sustained; S3 probe-lifecycle bypass is sustained; S4 is not sustained as an independent contract violation because caller-owned retention was already an explicit owner boundary and the future-adapter sentence authorized nothing, but the cold seam is removed by the owner's narrower v1 decision. Spec: P1 is sustained only as ambiguity in amendment 004's pending-artifact wording; a mandatory self-referential seal/deadline is rejected. P2 cold-before-hot orphan state is sustained and eliminated rather than specified. P3 exact preservation of superseded manifests is sustained. P4 the cold-stream exception to the frozen Git-reference rule is sustained. P5 is sustained insofar as a failure class alone does not establish irreducible evidentiary value; any claim that fail-closed scanning/write failures must nevertheless retain bytes is rejected under the frozen infrastructure-failure law.

The exact minimal Fixer scope is one forward authority correction, without rewriting prior amendments, Receipts, reviews, judgments, or manifests. It shall: (1) adopt owner-synthesis-006 and expressly supersede amendment 004's generic cold stream and amendment 005's generic raw-session admission/retention; Recorder v1 has no cold root, locator, admission reasons/ranges, compression/chunking, retention policy, or second storage temperature; (2) freeze capture/scan/extraction and staged small-core assembly, then required raw-scratch cleanup, then atomic promotion—cleanup failure or promotion failure is Recorder infrastructure failure and leaves no apparently complete docket; a final manifest exists only for successful core promotion, records the child outcome and successful Recorder completion, preserves child diagnostics when both fail, gives Recorder failure outward precedence, and never synthesizes a Receipt; (3) admit no generic raw object or range: lifecycle evidence must be created through the affected seam as one canonical fixture/probe artifact, then deleted or graduated exactly once under CLAUDE probe law, with no Recorder-held duplicate, and supplied as a whole byte-sealed ordinary exhibit; (4) identify an already committed artifact only by mechanically verified repository identity/full commit/path/blob OID/SHA-256, while storing each genuinely new Receipt, decision artifact, external input, or exhibit once by canonical path plus exact-byte digest; embedded/session echoes create no artifact, generated bytes are not a pending Git reference, the caller owns commit, and downstream closure binds the actual full HEAD where required—no follow-up self-seal merely restates Git; (5) require every authority/task/input byte and every claim-supporting exhibit to be either such a verified Git reference or one stored byte-sealed artifact; omission/disposition cannot satisfy this requirement and reference/admission/redaction/cleanup/promotion failure follows frozen Recorder-infrastructure, atomicity, and no-Receipt-synthesis law; (6) require final-branch reconstruction from the default branch or an equivalent Git-object-removing construction, not forward deletion, preserving exact small historical Receipts, manifests, authority, reviews, adjudications, plans, and migration dispositions, while adding separate forward supersession/disposition records for manifests that cite omitted payloads and excluding the 398 MiB session/tool-event blobs as execution exhaust; and (7) require the later Plan/Apply evidence to report the exact logical-byte size of the reconstructed issue-10 claim-chain tree and mechanically show that its ancestry/inventory contains no generic session or tool-event payload, with 'a few MiB' retained as the owner objective rather than a new retention engine. No Recorder implementation, test fixture, archived-payload inspection, cold-store replacement, LFS, archive service, summarizer, model admission role, database, daemon, or automatic Git mutation belongs in this Fixer repair.
